initialExam.title: RBI Grade B Officer 2026
initialExam.description: RBI Grade B Officer exam for India's central bank. One of the most prestigious positions in the banking sector.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduation with 60% or equivalent CGPA from recognized university
initialExam.syllabus: Phase-I: GK (80Q), English (30Q), Quant (30Q), Reasoning (60Q). Phase-II: Economic & Social Issues, English Writing, Finance & Management.
initialExam.examPattern: Phase-I: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Phase-II: 3 papers, 300 marks, 3 hours total. Interview.
initialExam.jobRole: Grade B Officer in Reserve Bank of India
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade B → Grade C → Grade D → Grade E → Grade F → CGM → Deputy Governor → Governor.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit opportunities.rbi.org.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: Subsidized accommodation, Medical, Pension, LFC, Interest-free loans
